description: A clip on the lower track cut into three stretches by an overlay entering and leaving above it, over a source whose colour changes half way. The bed is one second of red then one second of green; the overlay is a narrow white strip covering timeline frames 20-39, so the bed stays visible at the sides throughout. Frames 35 and 45 are the discriminators: the bed must be green there, because the second and third stretches resume at source frames 20 and 40 rather than restarting. A clip that restarted its source at every cut on an unrelated track would show red at both, and would look perfectly correct in every fixture whose sources are a single flat colour.
